The '''Casino''' is located in [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]] accessed through the back door of the [[Oasis]]. Access is initially blocked by the [[Bouncer]] until [[Quests#The Mysterious Qi|"The Mysterious Qi" quest]] is completed.

[[Mr. Qi]] is constantly present in the room. To his right is a machine to exchange gold for Qi coins, at a rate of {{Price|1000}} per {{Price|100|Qi}}, or {{Price|10}} per {{Price|1|Qi}} value. Qi coins are used for both gambling and purchasing items inside the Casino, and cannot be converted back to gold.

To the top-left of the room is a terminal that lists multiple statistics for [[the Player]].

There are two forms of gambling available, [[Slot Machine|slot machine]]s and a variant of BlackJack, [[CalicoJack]]. There are two tables for CalicoJack, low stakes ({{Price|100|Qi}}) to the left and high stakes ({{Price|1000|Qi}}) to the right.

In the upper right corner of the room, to the right of the machine for exchanging Qi coins and next to a potted plant, stands a shady individual who offers to sell [[Statue Of Endless Fortune|Statues Of Endless Fortune]] for {{Price|1000000}} each.

==Store==
The store is located in the top right of the casino. 

In some resolution settings, you may be unable to access the store without using the 'use button' or zooming out (go to menu, options).

==Tips==
* Press "y" on [[Controls#Keyboard & Mouse|mouse/keyboard]] to answer "yes" to the dialogue box at the Qi coin vending machine.

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|Fixed bug where crafting stats would be 0 if the player had not crafted an item the day of visiting the Casino.}}
{{History|1.4|Casino minigames now slightly favor the player. Random number generation fixed to prevent repeating patterns in [[Slot Machine]]s.}}
{{History|1.5|Store now stocks [[Modern Double Bed]].}}
{{History|1.6|Casino now has limited stocks of items. Added fireworks, [[wallpaper]]s, and a [[flooring]].}}
{{History|1.6.4|Qi coins now show up in the shop menu.}}
